rules.title: The VCT {year} format
rules.lead: In {year} VCT enters an open era: Partners get a head start, but every place after that has to be earned.
rules.modelText: Kickoff in Bangkok features 12 teams: 8 Partner teams (their only guaranteed berth of the year) and 4 teams from the regional Kickoff Qualifiers: Korea (1), Japan (1), Southeast Asia (1), and the 4-team Kickoff LCQ (2 South Asia, 1 Oceania, SEA runner-up). The top 3 qualify for Masters Seoul.
rules.partnerText: Partners are only guaranteed a slot at Kickoff. Any team (Partner or Open) that qualifies for Masters Seoul or Masters Valencia skips Open Qualifiers and Play-Ins, earning a direct seed into the top 4 of the next Regional Playoffs. Teams that miss Masters drop to their Regional Play-Ins (8 teams); finishing at the bottom of Play-Ins sends them back to the Open Qualifiers.
rules.partnerTerm: Partnerships run through at least 2028 and renew on a two-year cycle.
rules.cupText: Each Cup (Manila Cup 1 & Tokyo Cup 2) has 12 teams decided via 8-team Regional Playoffs: Korea 3, Japan 3, Southeast Asia (SEA) 2, Thailand 1, Indonesia 1, Vietnam 1, plus 1 berth from the 8-team Pacific Cup LCQ (Thailand #2-3, Indonesia #2-3, Vietnam #2, South Asia #1-2, and Oceania #1).
rules.continuityText: Open teams that keep at least 3 of their 5 starters retain their points and qualification status. Drop below 3 of 5 between Open Qualifiers and the team loses its progress and Championship Points.
rules.continuityNote: This progress rule is separate from the eligibility requirement in most regions that at least 3 of 5 players come from that region.
rules.stipendText: Fixed payments, separate from prize money. An open team that reaches every event could collect up to $1.1M in a season.
rules.stipendKickoff: Reaching Kickoff or a Cup (per event)
rules.skirmishText: In equally seeded matches, each team sends one player from its starting roster into a 1v1 duel before the match. The winner earns priority for map and side selection - replacing a coin toss.
rules.capsuleText: Partner teams keep receiving a share of digital item revenue. The {year} Team Capsules have not been revealed yet - this page will update when they are.
rules.unconfirmedNote: Items marked "Projected" have not been officially confirmed by Riot.
